grades.reason: The bound semantic artifact is an evidence-grounded, minimal, executable first-batch plan. It cites concrete repository convention sources (pyproject.toml, .pre-commit-config.yaml, Makefile, tests/unit/conftest.py, scripts/run_evidence_standardization.py, and existing direct-import test patterns); precisely defines the Pydantic v2 ValidationIssue contract and pure tuple-returning validate_jsonl API; preserves one-based physical line numbering and issue order while ignoring whitespace-only lines; deliberately rejects NaN, Infinity, and -Infinity via parse_constant, including nested occurrences; distinguishes all valid non-object JSON values from accepted dict objects including Unicode; and maps every bound pure-function edge case to focused real pytest coverage. The effectful batch is confined to the new standalone validator and new behavior-test file, uses no mocking or I/O, names focused pytest/Ruff/format/Pyright checks, and explicitly defers CLI, real-file tests, README, operator acceptance, and submission-gate work to a successor horizon enabled only after plan acceptance and candidate evidence. No implementation or downstream test completion is required at plan_verification.
